patch_description: Revert to the single-shared-parameter design (8 params total) that previously achieved the best combined score (0.80), and apply the recommended enhancement: replace the alternating XX(theta)/CZ nearest-neighbor entangling ring with an alternating XX(theta)/YY(theta) ring (still sharing the single "theta" parameter, zero new params). Using two non-commuting Ising interactions instead of one Ising + one fixed CZ increases the entangling expressivity of the ring without increasing parameter count, which should improve accuracy/generalization while preserving the excellent parameter economy and fast convergence of the earlier 0.80-scoring seed. The current 14-parameter two-theta design underperformed (0.72), so we discard it in favor of the proven 8-parameter architecture plus this targeted entangler improvement.
